label: boundaries
purpose: Boundaries refinement page. Refines a promoted candidate's [start_bp, end_bp] into approximate left/right boundary zones using multiple evidence tracks. Auto-propose runs BOUNDARY_TRACK_WEIGHTS-weighted algorithm (`_bndAutoPropose`); manual override at scrubber cursor via E (left) / F (right) hotkeys. Save (B) persists onto the candidate; Reset (R) clears.
